Package com.csse3200.game.components.spells.targeting

Interface EnemyTargetingStrategy

All Known Implementing Classes:
StrategyAll, StrategyClosest, StrategyOnscreen, StrategyWithinRadius
public interface EnemyTargetingStrategy
Selects which enemy entities an ability should affect. Implementations determine targeting specifics (i.e. all enemies, closest enemy, on-screen enemies) Keeps targeting separate from ability effects

    • selectTargets

      com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Array<Entity> selectTargets(Entity caster)
      Parameters:
      caster - the entity casting the spell
      Returns:
      enemies selected by this strategy; never null, may be empty

    • getRadius

      default float getRadius()
      Returns:
      how far from the caster this strategy reaches, in world units, or 0 when it is not bounded by a radius. Lets a spell show the area it covered without knowing how it was targeted; an unbounded strategy has no circle to draw.
